R&D, Sales, and Application teams.We are looking for creative minds with high ambitions who see the seemingly impossible as a challenge and love to achieve innovative breakthroughs in a global, multidisciplinary team.Please submit your application in English.For questions, feel free to contact us at talents@novami.com (https://mailto:talents@novami.com) .Responsibilities- Leading divisional product management, marketing, and application development activities- Driving the divisional product development lifecycle in close collaboration with R&D and Sales- Developing and driving competitive positioning and value propositions to enable regional sales success- Driving technical review meetings with key customers to expand Sentronics AP market share- Representing Sentronics at global trade shows, including SEMICON, and delivering speaking engagements at technology conferences- Aligning with internal and external stakeholders on customer demo development and execution- ·Aligning cross-divisional segmentation strategies with other Nova divisions- Acting as the primary representative of Sentronics/Nova across all company-wide marketing initiatives and eventsRequirements- Strong scientific background with at least a Master’s degree, preferably in Physics, Optics, or a related field- 10+ years of relevant industry experience, including at least 5 years in leading technical marketing/product management activities within the semiconductor WFE environment- Deep, hands-on expertise in metrology requirements within semiconductor fabs- Proven About UsWe make the business of games work for the people who make them.rcp is an independent production house from Munich, around since 2005. Part dealmaker, part production house, part backer. We sit on the business side of the table for a family of 15 partner studios across Europe, South America and South Asia, so they can spend their time making games. When our studios win, we win.What that looks like day to day:• We sell our studios’ games and teams to publishers and platforms• We structure deals, funding and investment• We broker co-development, porting and work-for-hire• We build serious games for finance, health and defenseMore than 300 games and interactive projects so far, from Songs of Silence and Bus Simulator to Angry Birds Epic and Ostwind.Where we’re going We’re building something the games industry doesn’t have yet: a 'United Artists' for game makers. Studios that own their work, share the upside and back each other.rcp has a strong reputation and a weak brand. For you, that’s room: you get to put your own stamp on it.How we work• Roles, not positions. Inspired by holacracy. One person often holds several roles, and roles change as the work changes• Strikeforces. Small cross-functional teams around a partner studio or a mission, with clear accountability for each role• Radical candor. We care personally and challenge directly. You get honest feedback, and we expect you to give it, including to the CEO• AI-second, human-first. Coordination and admin go to AI, so people spend their time on judgment, relationships and dealsYour role: Remote (Europe or North America, on European hours) or Munich · Full-time · Exclusive freelance start possible, then permanentThe short version We need a dealmaker who opens doors at the top table and brings the close home. You take over the relationships our CEO built over 20 years, and you build your own. No team to manage. A direct line to the CEO.Why this role exists Our CEO built rcp’s top relationships over 20 years. We want someone to take them over, grow them, and become the face of rcp at the top table.You open doors at Director and VP level. You bring opportunities that hold up. You bring the close home without giving terms away early. A door-opener with soft leads doesn’t help us. A door-opener who closes does.This is a director-level role as an individual contributor. You don’t manage a team. You work directly with our CEO, our Biz team and the studio heads across the rcp family.Your responsibilities will include:• Open doors at the right level: Director and VP+ at large publishers and platforms, CEO level at smaller publishers, plus project financiers, games investors and fast-growing self-publishing developers• Pitch and sell projects from the rcp family: original IP, co-development and work-for-hire• Hold terms to the close. When a deal doesn’t fit, rethink it instead of forcing it• Own our presence at D.I.C.E., GDC and Gamescom: the plan, the meetings, the follow-ups• Take over and grow our relationships with first-party platforms, major publishers and tool providers• Be the senior sparring partner for our Biz team: review deal rationales, mentor, keep commitments visible• Bring what you hear in the market back into the groupYour profile:• A seat in the circles where games deals happen: D.I.C.E., GamesBeat, or their equivalents in LA and Asia. Established, or clearly on your way in• Relationships at Director or VP level and above, across more than one segment: publishers, platforms, investors or tool providers• At least one deal in the last three years that you originated or led to the close• A confident presence in front of C-level. Quick and sharp• Drive. You set your own goals and get things done through people, without direct reports• Readiness to travel a lot, and the energy to enjoy it• A real feel for entertainment. You play games• Business-fluent English. German is a bonusNice to have:• Experience with funding, licensing or joint ventures• You’ve sat on both sides of the table, developer and publisher• You’ve worked in an owner-led company• You already use AI for research, prep and follow-upsWho this is not for• You want to build and lead a team from day one• You need a big brand behind you to get a meeting• You’d rather have a clear job description than build somethingAbout usTo find out more about remote control productions go to our website: www.rcp.familyand sign up for our newsletter !What we offer:• Real influence: a direct line to the CEO and a voice in group strategy• Where it can go: stay the face of rcp, lead one of our partner studios, or help make our own games• Fixed pay, no commission. You’re paid to build the right deals, not to push the most deals through• A family of game makers across three continents• Munich or remote: work from our office in the heart of Munich, or remotely from Europe or North America on European hours. Permanent employment or freelance, whichever fits you and your country• Health coaching with OLAO HEALTH. In Munich: Deutschlandticket, a games library and team events

jobs.description: Build Europe's semiconductor future with us!European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. ESMC represents a shared commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem.For our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and committed:System Specialist for Incoming Material Quality & Reliability (IMQR) (m/f/d)As our System Specialist for Incoming Material Quality & Reliability (IMQR) (m/f/d), you will be the gatekeeper of quality, ensuring that only the highest-standard materials make it into our production line. By setting up advanced web-based systems, building key interfaces with suppliers, and shaping our quality processes from day one, your footprint will be embedded in every microchip we manufacture. If you love precision and thrive in an environment where you can actively build the structures you work with, this is your stage.Job Responsibilities• Set up and optimize our advanced web-based IMQR systems and establish automated data transfer protocols with global suppliers from the ground up.• Take ownership of material usage decisions and master data maintenance within SAP, ensuring a continuous, in-time supply of premium materials into the Fab.• Collect raw data and monitor Statistical Process Control (SPC) charts, transforming it into strategic operational workflows.• Act as the first point of contact for troubleshooting. Train internal teams as well as external international suppliers on our systems.• Collaborate closely with engineering teams to systematically improve productivity through optimized data management.Your profile• A completed vocational training (Berufsausbildung), paired with 2–5 years of professional experience in a comparable quality, data, or technical role within an international high-tech environment.• Solid expertise in data management, reporting, and ERP systems (ideally SAP), combined with a good understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC) systems.• You thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments and view evolving processes as an opportunity to actively shape workflows. Detail-focused. Highly resilient.• Fluent in English (our company language and communication to colleagues in Taiwan and Arizona).• Experience in a high-tech manufacturing industry. Plus, basic language skills in German or Mandarin to ease local and global collaboration.• Ready for Training at TSMC in Taiwan for 6 months.Reasons to join ESMC• Security & Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs.• Company Pension Plan & Financial Benefits : We support your financial well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).• Relocation Support for Dresden: Moving for us?
